findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dish machine to measure 0ppm chlorine after repeated cycles. The PIC was informed and maintenance was requested. The PIC told the inspector that the staff are currently using the triple sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize before items pass through the dish machine. Ensure wash, rinse, sanitize practices with the triple sink are maintained until the dish machine is repaired. A follow-up will be conducted on 5/21/2026 to ensure the dish machine is repaired.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the interior baffles of the ice machine to be soiled with black debris. The PIC was informed and plans to deep clean/sanitize the machine. Ensure the ice machine is clean to sight and touch prior to the follow-up scheduled on 5/28/2026.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the following physical facilities in need of repair:
1. There is a hole in the wall near the door of the dry storage area.
2. There is a hole in the wall near the back door of the facility.
3. The wall behind the soda syrup boxes is damaged and brittle. 

Ensure these areas are repaired to be smooth and easily cleanable prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
